title: Scriptorium
description: Built from Anthony's Scriptorium design system: Cardo text in iron-gall ink on a vellum wash, blackletter titles, rubric labels in IM Fell small capitals, glosses in lapis italic, a gilded or vermilion drop cap opening each chapter, and the asymmetric folio of a real leaf (narrow gutter, wide outer margin, deep foot). Ornaments are type (❧ ✠ ⁂), never drawn borders.
best_for: Lectionaries, the Rule, florilegia, glossed texts, devotional books with commentary in the margin.

ground.help: vellum: tonal wash printed to the edge (file gets bleed); white: plain paper

ruling.help: plummet bounding lines around the text block, as pricked and ruled on a leaf

colour: colour (vermilion, lapis, gold; vellum ground); ground=white still needs colour for the rubrics
